text: {"name":"rf_update_power_compensation","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Computes a power-dependent compensation value from the maximum of four input values, stores it at offset 8 of the PHY configuration, and reloads the PHY table.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"power_inputs","a2":"phy_config","v3":"max_power_input","v5":"existing_compensation","v6":"power_db"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"First candidate power input"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Second candidate power input"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Third candidate power input; in the PHY configuration, this field holds the compensation value"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Fourth candidate power input"}]}
